notes: Version 2.58 records the LC correction in LorentzCapacity 1.5, TempProj 1.6, LC-O1 1.3 and LC-Synthesis 2.4. The quadratic Born-Infeld budget is a hypothesis of LorentzCapacity, motivated by the capacity axiom [A-cap] of BornInfeld and including the choice of c_BI equal to the [A-cap] bound; it is not derived from [A-cap], a per-node inequality on the relaxation rate, and BornInfeld leaves that passage open.
